name: Indonesian Gado-Gado with Hardboiled Eggs, Veggies & Peanut Sauce (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium and 4 mini food storage containers.
Fill a medium saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
227 g green beans
1 lime
½ English cucumber
1 pint grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Trim green beans. Once the water in the pan is boiling, add beans and cook until bright green and tender-crisp, about 2 minutes. Transfer beans to a colander using a slotted spoon, run under cold water to cool, then transfer to a paper towel-lined plate. (Return water to a boil for the next step.)

Once the water in the pan returns to a boil, gently lower eggs into the water using the slotted spoon. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 8 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.

Meanwhile, juice lime into a small bowl. Add peanut butter, water, soy sauce, sugar, chili-garlic sauce, vinegar, and oil, then whisk to combine the peanut sauce. Divide between mini containers, cover with lids, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup natural peanut butter
4 tsp soy sauce
4 tsp brown sugar
1 ½ tsp chili-garlic sauce
1 ½ tsp rice vinegar
1 tsp toasted sesame oil

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice cucumber crosswise at an angle, into ¼-inch thick pieces. Place on another plate.
Peel, trim, and quarter carrots lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 3-inch long sticks. Add to the plate with the cucumber, along with tomatoes.
Peel and halve eggs. Add to the plate.
Divide green beans, cucumbers, carrots, tomatoes, and eggs between medium food storage containers. Cover containers, then refrigerate along with the peanut sauce.
When ready to eat, use peanut sauce as a dip for the veggies and eggs. Enjoy!
